trustBadges.title: Strictly No Data Selling
trustBadges.desc: We never sell, monetize, or broker your customer leads, electricity bills, or installer records to any third parties.

trustBadges.title: Multi-Tenant Data Isolation
trustBadges.desc: Every solar installer operates within a logically isolated workspace. Competitors can never access your pipeline.

trustBadges.title: PM Surya Ghar & Subsidy Security
trustBadges.desc: Customer Aadhaar, DISCOM consumer numbers, and subsidy applications are encrypted with AES-256 and TLS 1.3.

trustBadges.title: Granular Role-Based Access (RBAC)
trustBadges.desc: Control which field engineers, sales agents, or accountants can view customer pricing, documents, and payments.
